new_source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    split = next((('row', i) for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                  if len(set(row)) == 1 and i not in (0, height - 1)), None)
    if split is None:
        split = next((('col', j) for j in range(width)
                      if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(height)}) == 1
                      and j not in (0, width - 1)), None)

    if split[0] == 'row':
        i = split[1]
        first, second = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
    else:
        j = split[1]
        first = [row[:j] for row in grid]
        second = [row[j + 1:] for row in grid]

    common = set(value for row in first for value in row) & set(value for row in second for value in row)
    background = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else background
             for c in range(len(first[0]))]
            for r in range(len(first))]
'''
